settings.section_content:
Across India, to 19,000+ pin codes. Enter yours on any product page to check before you order.
We don't ship outside India yet.
Once your order is placed on our website and payment is confirmed, it will ship within 48 hours. You can expect delivery within 7 business days.

Orders over ₹499: FREE Shipping.
Orders under ₹499: A flat shipping fee of ₹50 applies.
Special Sales: During specific promotional events, we may offer site-wide free shipping. These exceptions will be explicitly announced on our homepage and official social media handles.
To keep your deliveries smooth and hassle-free, all Purrkins orders are prepaid securely at checkout. Just place your order, relax, and we’ll handle the rest.
Tracking stuck for more than 48 hours, or a delivery marked complete that never arrived? Write to care@purrkins.com or WhatsApp +91 90000 00000 with your order ID and we'll chase the courier.

settings.intro: We know hungry kittens don’t like to wait. We pack every order with love to get your cat's fresh meals to your door safely and speedily.
